subject.title: Hard-delete or runtimeId migration needed for @apify/apify-openclaw-plugin

question: Should an authorized ClawHub admin apply the runtimeId repair to the production Apify package, or choose hard-delete/another migration path after verifying package ownership and collision state?
rationale: The remaining work is a production package identity mutation for executable plugin distribution, so source automation cannot safely decide or apply it without maintainer authority and security-boundary checks.

options.title: Run guarded runtimeId repair
options.body: Use the admin dry-run/apply flow after verifying Apify ownership, current package state, and no active runtimeId collision.

options.title: Hard-delete or retire entry
options.body: Use a destructive package path only if the runtimeId repair cannot preserve the intended package identity safely.

options.title: Wait for stronger identity proof
options.body: Keep the package blocked until maintainers have enough publisher or organizational proof to authorize the mutation.

recommendation.title: Run guarded runtimeId repair
recommendation.body: Use the admin dry-run/apply flow after verifying Apify ownership, current package state, and no active runtimeId collision.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the relevant admin repair flows and handled the analogous OpenViking production repair path.
